description: A link that opens the structure in HexSketch (in the browser, nothing to install), where the user can edit it by drawing and copy it back. Give it to the user whenever they may want to change a structure.

structure.description: The structure: SMILES (e.g. "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O"), molfile or CDXML text, or a HexSketch link (https://hexsketch.com/#smiles=... or #cdxml=...). Not a name.

style.description: Drawing style: hexsketch (default) or acs (ACS 1996 journal style).

name: structure_link
title: Link to edit in HexSketch
